messages:
maya_cs: Quick sync — Acme West renewal 2w out. Legal asked for signer matrix + billing entity confirmation. Procurement is signaling PO preference. cc @natalie_legal @leo_fin @sam_onboard
jordan_ae: Confirmed — customer procurement replied. They want a PO instead of CC. Said CFO must sign. They also asked for our vendor code and remit address.
natalie_legal: Need exact legal entity name on the contract and the signatory authority doc. If PO required, we'll likely need a short KMS addendum for Dedicated deployments.
leo_fin: Billing entity on our side should be "Acme West LLC (EU)". I've opened vendor code request — ticket FIN-4821. Net30 preferred by them.
sam_onboard: Heads up — switching to PO + KMS clause can push onboarding by ~3 business days (SAML cert exchange + KMS provisioning). I'll bubble up dependencies.
maya_cs: Action list: 1) jordan confirm PO + get PO form and procurement contact 2) natalie to pull signer authority and draft KMS addendum 3) leo to follow vendor code ticket 4) sam to log onboarding delta. I'll send a summary to the customer by EOD. :thumbsup:
jordan_ae: Pinged procurement contact, got email procurement@acmewest.com. Waiting on filled PO.
opsbot: Renewal-bot: Reminder — renewal window: 14 days remaining for account acme-west (acct 12345).
natalie_legal: Drafting KMS addendum now. If CFO signs for a different legal entity we should mark signature fields as TBD to avoid accepting wrong entity.
leo_fin: Vendor code returned: VC-ACME-042. Updating invoice metadata.
jordan_ae: Procurement says CFO will sign; I'll prepare DocuSign envelope after we confirm PO number and vendor code.
maya_cs: Good. Can we pre-fill envelope with a placeholder for billing entity but annotate as "TBD until PO received"? I want to avoid blocking the signature step.
natalie_legal: OK to prefill but mark language that signature does not finalize invoice entity until PO verifies entity. I'll add a short clause.
sam_onboard: Note: if CFO signs an entity different from the one we pre-provisioned for SSO, we'll need to reissue invites. Recommend final signer before provisioning SSO accounts.
jordan_ae: Vendor code + PO confirmed. PO#: 123-PO-9876. Sending envelope now.
maya_cs: Thanks — please include PO# in envelope subject and body. Will flag renewal tracker for potential +3 day onboarding slip.
jordan_ae: DocuSign sent: envelope 0x9f3bd (https://docusign.internal/0x9f3bd)
maya_cs: I'll follow up Wed if not signed. If procurement asks for amendment we'll loop in legal immediately.
opsbot: Activity-log: vendor code updated, PO attached, envelope created.
